description: Banner-sized approximation of the photographed Dresden skyline
basis: Each row [A, mu, w, p] contributes A*exp(-((x-mu)/w)^p)
fitting_note: 18-term nonlinear fit to the previous detailed smooth outline; 56 fitted values (18 amplitudes, 18 centers, 18 widths, baseline and slope) rounded to integers. Powers were fixed design choices, not fitted parameters.
attribution: Outline adapted from Michele Vascellari's photograph
